item.title: Rive State Machines
item.description: rive listner’s action > input change In Rive, you can switch between different State Machines without using JavaScript by utilizing Events and Inputs within the Rive Editor itself. However, note that fully dynamic switching between State Machines at runtime typically requires code (JS/Flutter/etc.). That said, here are ways to simulate State Machine switching inside Rive Editor without external code: Method 1: Use a “Master State Machine” to Control Others If you have multiple State Machines (e.g., Movement and Combat), you can create a “Controller” State Machine that toggles between them using Boolean Inputs.
